rv.q: Steven Webb puts forward a one-man performance that is stunningly brilliant.
Webb gives a lightning-fast performance that boggles the mind (in terms velocity and virtuosity).

Webb is so enchantingly charming and endearing that he can enable Feeling Afraid to float by on its funniness. But the actor's adorableness can only go so far because the character's personality hinges almost entirely on diminishing his own self-worth.
